scope: Ghidra MCP annotation refactor of selected original binary functions; PE bytes immutable; no target execution or Unity gameplay changes.

functions.name: ApplyUnitSnapshot
functions.comment: Original export resetcharacter(unitinfo*). Apply the supplied unit snapshot into the runtime character array at unit*0x2e0. Copies unit/job/x/y and other fields; this is not a complete replacement implementation. Called by received records and scripted actor creation.

functions.name: SpawnActorFromScriptArguments
functions.comment: Original export dmSetChar(char*). Parse scripted actor identity, resolve the ability/picture record, build a temporary unitinfo, and call resetcharacter. This path must not be conflated with initial battle deployment.

functions.name: BuildScriptUnitSnapshot
functions.comment: Build the temporary unitinfo used by dmSetChar. Observed offsets: unit+0x00, job+0x04, native tile X+0x48, Y+0x4c. Other fields retain their original meaning/unknown status.

functions.name: UpdateScriptActorPlacement
functions.comment: Original export dmSetChar2. Update an existing unit placement/related state, clear previous occupancy, and register the new native tile. Do not count this as a separate initial monster roster loader.

functions.name: LoadScenarioAiRules
functions.comment: Original export readai(). Opens Map\<scenario>set.arc and reads <scenario>.ai. Interpret AI commands separately from a recovered SET/POS battle roster.

functions.name: ActivateUnitAndCommanderAi
functions.comment: Original export setmonsterai. For the selected active unit and its decimal commander floor(unit/10)*10, write AI state +0x108=2 when the original eligibility fields are nonzero. This activates AI; it does not load a monster roster or determine job/count.

functions.name: DispatchUnitAiByRole
functions.comment: Original export _ai. Branch using unit modulo10: commander slots and soldier slots use different AI execution paths. This selects AI behavior, not initial spawn coordinates.

functions.name: ReceiveGamePacket
functions.comment: Original export OnPacketReceive. Nonempty packet input is forwarded into the game packet dispatcher; no target execution has been observed.

functions.name: DispatchGamePacket
functions.comment: Dispatch the game message opcode and, for0x5c, its subtype. Subtypes0x50 and0x51 invoke separate unit snapshot decoders. Do not infer actual historical scenario contents from this capability.

functions.name: DecodeUnitSnapshot_5C50
functions.comment: Decode the5C50 message body (the caller skips the two opcode bytes), construct unitinfo, call UserUnit.resetcharacter. Whole-message placement offsets: unit2, job6, native tileX30,Y32. Other fields are preserved rather than assigned guessed meanings.

functions.name: DecodeUnitSnapshot_5C51
functions.comment: Decode the extended5C51 body, construct unitinfo and call UserUnit.resetcharacter. Whole-message placement offsets: unit2,job6,native tileX42,Y44. This is a received snapshot, not a file roster parser.

functions.name: ExecuteCharPosCommand
functions.comment: Parse the scene CHARPOS arguments, resolve commander aliases and construct the string passed to UserUnit.dmSetChar. Scripted actors must remain separate from an initial battle roster.

functions.name: LoadScenarioBriefing
functions.comment: Read the scenario .srf resource and parse its briefing/condition text. Do not interpret the existence of a briefing as a complete initial monster roster.

functions.name: LoadScenarioEventActions
functions.comment: Read the scenario .evt and populate client event action storage. Numeric-prefixed condition lines are distinguished from executable action lines; this is not an initial unit roster loader.

functions.name: LoadCommonGameTables
functions.comment: Original export ReadSetFiles(options). Read common tile/item/ability-related tables according to original flags. The name setunit does not establish a scenarioNN.set/NN.pos roster loader.

functions.name: LoadTileAttributeTable
functions.comment: Original export ReadTileAttr(char*). Read tile attribute data from common resources; retain original table selection and error propagation.

functions.name: LoadAbilityDefinitionTables
functions.comment: Read ability.atr or ability1.atr from GameRes\set.arc according to the original selection flag. The file literals and original sscanf record stores establish common ability definitions, not per-scenario initial coordinates.

functions.name: LoadItemDefinitionTables
functions.comment: Read itemtbl.atr or itemtbl1.atr from GameRes\set.arc according to the original selection flag. The table stores common item definitions, not per-scenario monster deployment.

functions.name: LoadMagicDefinitionTables
functions.comment: Read common magic-related definitions using original table filenames and error handling; no synthetic gameplay rules are introduced.

functions.name: ReplaceAndLoadMapGeometry
functions.comment: Original BBDX_MapManager::LoadMap(CString&). Destroy/recreate BB_Map with the existing resource array, decode the selected MRC, report progress and apply TileAttrChange on success. The outer Load routine performs GRS acquisition.

functions.name: DecodeMrcMapGeometry
functions.comment: Original BB_Map::LoadMap(path,callback). Decode map resource IDs/dimensions, background arrays, tile records and decorative sprites. No unknown trailing bytes are invented as a monster roster.

functions.name: LoadMapResourcesAndGeometry
functions.comment: Original BBDX_MapManager::Load(CString). Open-check the path; read required GRS indices, reuse/load graphics and surfaces, call LoadMap, and reset visible sprite cache. No UserUnit creation call is present in this function.

functions.name: ResetVisibleSpriteCache
functions.comment: Original StartPosAndValidSpriteInit. Set four cached view coordinates to -100, delete the prior visible-sprite index buffer, and allocate a new index buffer of mapSpriteCount*4 bytes. This is map rendering cache initialization, not monster spawn placement.

functions.name: LoadScenarioAiAndEventMembers
functions.comment: Read <scenario>.ai and <scenario>.evt from Map\<scenario>set.arc. Keep member retrieval separate from runtime unit creation.

functions.name: RouteReceivedGameMessage
functions.comment: Native SEH prologue verified in original bytes. Handle selected outer message cases and forward the game payload into GameCtl.OnPacketReceive at0x441b0a. REA automatic containing-function lookup did not identify this body; boundary is recovered in the separate Ghidra project, not claimed as an MCP annotation.

functions.name: PopulateActorsFromUnitRecords_A
functions.comment: Native SEH prologue verified. Iterate stored unit records, call UserUnit.dmSetChar and dmSetChar2 using record identity/job/coordinates. This observation alone does not establish where the record array originated. REA did not identify the containing function; recover only in the separate project.

functions.name: PopulateActorFromUnitRecord_B
functions.comment: Process the supplied unit record, update related local structures and create/update its actor via dmSetChar and dmSetChar2. This function is not itself a complete initial monster roster or proof of the record source.

functions.name: PopulateActorFromUnitRecord_C
functions.comment: Build a scripted-actor string from a stored unit record, call dmSetChar and update its placement with dmSetChar2. Runtime record use is separate from roster file discovery.
